home.metaTitle: A home for Arabic developer writing
home.heroLead: A social platform for Arabic-speaking developers. Publish technical write-ups with code blocks, tables and images, follow the people working on what you work on, and read a feed that actually ends.
home.screenshotAlt: The ArabDev dashboard: the feed, a technical post and the interests sidebar
home.aboutTitle: Built for technical writing in Arabic
home.aboutBody1: Most of what Arabic-speaking developers write gets lost on platforms that were never designed for the language: mirrored layouts, fonts that fight the script, and editors that mangle code.
home.aboutBody2: ArabDev starts from Arabic instead of adding it later. Every paragraph picks its own direction, so an Arabic sentence and an English snippet live in one post without breaking — and all of it is open source, so you can read exactly what it does.
home.about1Body: The whole interface flips direction, and counts use correct Arabic plural forms.
home.about2Body: Every line is public. Run your own copy, or send a patch.
home.about3Body: Your feed follows the people and topics you picked, in an order you can predict.
home.about4Body: Twenty posts at a time, self-hosted fonts, and images re-encoded before they are stored.
home.featuresSub: A small, deliberate set of tools, each working in both languages, on desktop and phone.
home.f1Body: Headings, lists, quotes, tables, links and code blocks, with live preview and saved drafts.
home.f2Body: “For you” ranks your day by who you follow and what you like; Following and Latest keep it simple.
home.f3Body: Tags are normalised automatically and mapped to 25 interests, so posts reach the right readers.
home.f4Body: Five kinds, each with its own switch, and you decide who may mention you. No marketing email.
home.f5Body: Argon2id passwords, rotating sessions that spot stolen tokens, and limits that stop guessing.
home.f6Body: Dark mode follows your device, and text colours in posts stay readable in both.
home.stepsTitle: Three steps to your first post
home.step1Body: A username, an email and a password. No phone number, no payment details.
home.step2Body: Four short steps: a picture, a bio, your topics, and developers worth following.
home.step3Body: A walkthrough, a problem you solved, or an open-source project you want tried.
home.privacyBody: Not a setting you can switch off, but a decision underneath the platform: no data brokers, no advertising profiles, and no third-party tracking code anywhere on the site.
home.p1Body: Chosen by position and interface language alone. Everyone sees the same ones.
home.p2Body: Camera and GPS data are stripped from every image before it is stored.
home.p3Body: Deleting your account removes your posts, interactions and uploads immediately.
home.p4Body: You can read what the platform does instead of taking our word for it.
home.docsSub: Three sites, in Arabic and English, readable without an account.
home.docsWiki: 25 articles covering every feature, safety, troubleshooting and development.
home.docsPrivacy: 28 plain-language sections: what we collect, why, and for how long.
home.docsPatch: What changed in every release, filterable by type of change.
home.contactTitle: Two addresses, read by a person
home.contactSub: Write in Arabic or English. We acknowledge within 7 days and answer fully within 30.
home.contactSupportBody: Your account, bugs, reporting content, privacy requests and security reports.
home.contactHelloBody: Sponsorship and ads, contributing code or translations, partnerships and press.
home.finalBody: Join the developers writing in Arabic about the work they actually do.
home.footerAbout: A social platform for Arabic-speaking developers, open source under the GNU GPL v3.
home.footerRights: © 2026 ArabDev · Made for the Arabic developer community
